text: …　なんだ　ゲーム　やりたいのか？

structure.jp: ゲーム　やりたいのか？
structure.en: you want to play the games?

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do' it. やりたい = 'want to play'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end is a blunt, manly way of asking 'is that how it is?'. やりたいのか = 'so you want to play, do you?'
